## Applied Materials, AMD, Intel, KLA, and Kulicke & Soffa Trade Lower in Semiconductor Equipment Pullback

Equipment leaders AMAT and KLA declining alongside chip designers is a confirmation signal that the market is marking down the full capex cycle—not just near-term chip demand—which is the most bearish read for the semiconductor infrastructure complex heading into earnings season.

- AMAT, AMD, INTC, KLA, and Kulicke and Soffa all declined simultaneously.
- The group spans chip designers, equipment makers, and IDMs, confirming broad sector pressure rather than single-name news.
- No company-specific catalyst is identified in the headline for any of the five names.
- This cluster adds equipment leaders (AMAT, KLA) to the semiconductor selloff already visible in clusters dfa6fc77976d0b92 and 0a2d7b0c2824e5a9.
